hero.title: About Me
hero.bio_p1: Second-year engineering student in Computer Science, AI & Cybersecurity at HESTIM Casablanca. Focused on offensive security (pentest) and SOC analysis, with particular interest in threat intelligence with MISP, defensive infrastructure automation (Ansible, Terraform), and NIST 2.0 governance frameworks.
hero.bio_p2: Currently looking for a PFA internship to put these skills into practice on real-world projects.
